creator: Alexander Terp
description:
herdr answers a mutation it considered and did not perform with an ordinary success plus a `declined` reason, so Muster logs a warning and reports `Ok`. Found by running the app: `muster zoom` on a tab with one pane exits 0 having done nothing, and the log says `single_pane` where nobody will read it.

Whether that is wrong depends on the verb. Zooming an only pane is arguably already zoomed; swapping a pane with no neighbour is not. The decision is which reasons a caller should be refused over, and it changes the keyboard path too - so it is one decision for both surfaces rather than a CLI-only fix.
title: 🤐 A declined intent is a success to everybody who asked
